speaker: Narrator
text: Welcome to Willowbrook, a quiet village of gardens and friendly neighbours. You are the village detective, and everyone knows you are good at finding things.

speaker: Marmalade
text: Hello! I'm Marmalade. I will help you. Use the arrow buttons to move, and press OK to choose.

speaker: Marmalade
text: Let's practise. Can you find your reading glasses?

speaker: Marmalade
text: Your reading glasses have two round lenses.

speaker: Marmalade
text: Well done! Now, some news. The lantern for tonight's autumn fair has gone dim. Three little light charms have rolled away around the village.

speaker: Narrator
text: You are ready to begin. Let's visit the bakery first.

speaker: Narrator
text: Well done, detective! You finished Welcome to Willowbrook.

text: Chapter 1. The Bakery. Help Mrs. Bramble at the bakery and find the first light charm.

text: The lantern for tonight's autumn fair has gone dim. We are finding three little light charms to make it shine again. Right now: Help Mrs. Bramble at the bakery and find the first light charm.

speaker: Narrator
text: The bakery smells of warm bread. Mrs. Bramble is busy baking for the fair.

speaker: Mrs. Bramble
text: Good morning, detective! I was baking a pear tart for the fair when a little light charm rolled off my table. Could you help me tidy up first?

speaker: Marmalade
text: Find the honey pot, the loaf of bread and the strawberries.

speaker: Marmalade
text: The honey pot is golden and round.

speaker: Marmalade
text: The loaf of bread is brown and crusty.

speaker: Marmalade
text: The strawberries are small and red.

speaker: Mrs. Bramble
text: Thank you, that's much tidier! My recipe cards are all mixed up. Each card has a twin. Could you put the pairs together?

speaker: Marmalade
text: Find two cards that are the same.

speaker: Mrs. Bramble
text: Lovely, all in pairs again! Now, a little question before we look for the charm.

speaker: Marmalade
text: What fruit was Mrs. Bramble using in her tart?

speaker: Marmalade
text: She told you when you arrived. It is a sweet green fruit.

speaker: Marmalade
text: Look! Something is twinkling under the last recipe card. It's the first light charm!

speaker: Narrator
text: You found the first light charm! Mrs. Bramble gives you a warm scone to say thank you. Two more charms to find.

speaker: Narrator
text: Well done, detective! You finished The Bakery.

text: The lantern for tonight's autumn fair has gone dim. We are finding three little light charms to make it shine again. Right now: Help Mr. Hollis in his garden and find the second light charm.

speaker: Narrator
text: Mr. Hollis's garden is bright with autumn colours. He is raking leaves into a tidy pile.

speaker: Mr. Hollis
text: Hello, detective! I saw something sparkle near the flower beds, but my eyes aren't what they were. Shall we look together?

speaker: Marmalade
text: Find the ladybird, the mushroom and the chestnut.

speaker: Marmalade
text: The ladybird is small and red with black spots.

speaker: Marmalade
text: The mushroom has a round cap and a little stalk.

speaker: Marmalade
text: The chestnut is shiny and brown.

speaker: Mr. Hollis
text: Thank you! Oh dear, my basket is all muddled. Some things belong in the garden, and some belong in the kitchen.

speaker: Marmalade
text: Put each thing where it belongs.

speaker: Marmalade
text: The sparkle is under the sleeping flowers. I know a kind spell to wake them for a moment. Watch, then do the same!

speaker: Marmalade
text: Watch the magic, then press the same symbols in the same order.

speaker: Marmalade
text: The flowers are opening! And look, there between the petals is the second light charm!

speaker: Mr. Hollis
text: Before you go, here is a riddle my grandmother used to tell me.

speaker: Marmalade
text: I am tall and yellow, and I turn my face to the sun. What am I?

speaker: Marmalade
text: Think of a big, bright yellow flower.

speaker: Narrator
text: You found the second light charm! Mr. Hollis gives you a bunch of autumn flowers. Just one more charm to find.

speaker: Narrator
text: Well done, detective! You finished The Garden.
